AddHookJson.description: The JSON shape of one listed hook.

actions.description: Each action in its one-line form.

name.description: The hook's name, or `null` when unnamed.

origin.description: The layer or pack that supplied the hook.

when.description: Its `when`, or the empty string when it fires every add.

description: The object `mt explain add --json` prints: every merged `[[on.add]]` hook, its `when`, its actions and its origin.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema this object conforms to.
